styleContinuityAnchors.colorSystem: Slate indigo brand #334155 with TRAE Work neutral grey surfaces. Brand color is scarce: primary CTA, active nav tab, logo mark only. Status colors from TRAE Work semantic tokens.
styleContinuityAnchors.shapeSystem: radius-8 default for cards/buttons/inputs, radius-12 for ds-card panels, radius-full only for tags/pills. No large rounded corners.
styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: SF Pro heading / SF Pro Text body. heading-3xs for eyebrow labels (11px/600). body-base 14px as baseline. font-family-metric (Inter) for numeric displays. font-family-mono (JetBrains Mono) for code.
styleContinuityAnchors.spacingSystem: TRAE Work spacer scale. Page padding 32px desktop. Section gaps 32-48px. Card padding 20px.
styleContinuityAnchors.componentLanguage: ds-* component classes from TRAE Work. ds-btn, ds-input, ds-select, ds-card, ds-tabs, ds-tag, ds-empty, ds-notif, ds-alert. No paper-card, no rounded-full buttons, no decorative gradients.
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceAndDepth: No shadows on static elements. Surface layering via bg-base-default / bg-base-secondary / bg-overlay-l1. Borders only via border-neutral-l1/l2.
styleContinuityAnchors.imageryAndIconography: TRAE Work inline SVG icons at 16px. No ornamental icons.
styleContinuityAnchors.interactionTone: Subtle hover via bg-overlay-l1/l2. Fast 120ms transitions. No scale effects.

sharedProjectShellContract.navigationShell: Fixed top header bar with app name left, nav tabs center (ds-tabs style with underline), user area right. Active tab uses --ink-brand (#334155) background fill, not underline.
sharedProjectShellContract.primaryColorSystem: Slate indigo #334155 as single brand hue. Hover: #1e293b. Active: #0f172a. Popup/surface: #f1f5f9.
sharedProjectShellContract.typographySystem: SF Pro heading, SF Pro Text body. heading-3xs (11px/600) eyebrow. heading-md (20px/600) for page titles. body-base (14px/400) for content.
sharedProjectShellContract.radiusScale: radius-8 (8px) default. radius-12 (12px) for cards. radius-full for tags/pills only.
sharedProjectShellContract.surfaceDepthModel: No shadows. Surface via bg-base-default/secondary/overlay. Borders via border-neutral-l1.
sharedProjectShellContract.ctaStyle: ds-btn with --ink-brand bg, --ink-brand-onbrand text, radius-8, height 32px (lg). Secondary: ds-btn--secondary.
sharedProjectShellContract.alignmentRules: Page content max-width ~1200px centered. Section gaps 32px.

brandOverride.description: Inkdesk uses custom slate-indigo brand #334155, overriding TRAE Work's --bg-brand #4b3fe3. All other tokens follow TRAE Work.
